## What subsequent inquiry actually changes

The [later matched-history reconstruction](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/INQUIRY-INTERFACE-ARGUMENT.md) establishes more than changed generator dispatch: under the same H3 process, the retained method changes native acquisition from three cycles to four. The narrower arm's first prediction test initially coincides with the broader arm's additional acquisition; the complete broader history contains another action/read pair. Misleading receipt causes this extra inquiry, so its reality does not establish its necessity or warrant.

The [sufficiency continuation](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/INQUIRY-SUFFICIENCY-INTEGRATION.md) further shows two compatible candidates agreeing on the next reading after `010`. The actual zero reading advances both without eliminating either; they then disagree about the newly next reading. Inquiry changes the conditions to which its retained distinctions apply. One-step agreement does not satisfy this learner's declared all-future model-acquisition contract, so the comparison does not license a shortcut under that unchanged contract. Acquiring and revising which unresolved differences matter to the actual continuation is the stronger target.

## 6 Wisdom as situated and revisable understanding

Later constructive studies give the following discussion an actual developmental sequence. Acquired observations can reject a candidate generator, form a replacement connection and later regenerate through that retained connection after the successful trial model has been discarded. In a separate matched history, an acquired signal changes native inquiry duration. The [organization reconstruction](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/CONSEQUENCE-ORGANIZATION-INTEGRATION.md) and [method chapter](METHOD-REVISION.md#what-subsequent-inquiry-actually-changes) preserve their separate ancestry, misleading evidence and supplied formation rules.

## F18 Constructive sufficiency through transforming inquiry

The existing generative process admits an exact constructive criterion for a bounded inquiry followed by an executable response. A query transports every compatible configuration through its actual step before filtering its acquired outcome. It must be enabled for each candidate and preserve the declared intermediate condition on every successor. A terminal response is one finite action sequence, common to the remaining candidates, whose every prefix can continue and whose every admitted endpoint meets the requirement.

The [Lean theorem `sufficiency_iff_bounded_policy`](../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/inquiry-root/sufficiency/InquirySufficiency.lean) equates the explicit empty/live-branch recurrence with existence of an independently defined finite policy at a fixed inquiry-depth bound. Actual execution remains a native trace, and separate theorems establish execution existence, endpoint adequacy and every-step preservation. Empty initial evidence is excluded. Exact finite candidate lists decide branch nonemptiness without a logical axiom; under bounded branch classification the constructive recurrence agrees with the older implication form.

The [public entry](../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/GenerativeInquirySufficiencyModel.lean) passes 17 new empty-dependency audits in an 18-module build. [Mathematical scope](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/INQUIRY-SUFFICIENCY-LEAN-MATH.md) and [review](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/INQUIRY-SUFFICIENCY-LEAN-REVIEW.md) preserve a key limit: finite observation labels alone do not decide arbitrary predicate-valued branch nonemptiness. The theorem asserts no physical law, calibration, ethical goal or acquired stopping mechanism. These are conditional contracts within one changing process; an application must identify and justify them.

## The unified theorem and its precise force

**Subsequent continuation:** [the Lean sufficiency integration](INQUIRY-SUFFICIENCY-LEAN-INTEGRATION.md) reconciles the summary gaps identified below and adds a constructive public formal interface.
